name: alert-dialog
behavior: APG alertdialog pattern (modal; role=alertdialog + aria-modal=true; focus trapped in the panel and Tab cycles; initial focus on the least destructive action; Esc closes and returns focus to the trigger; labelled by title, described by description — the description is REQUIRED, unlike dialog)

parts.note: narrower default than dialog — an alert dialog carries one decision, not a form
optional emphasis glyph above the title; tone follows the consequence of the confirming action
required — states the consequence; referenced by aria-describedby
action slot — end-aligned, stacks vertically on narrow viewports
the dismissing button (anatomy/button.json, secondary × outline); receives initial focus
the confirming button (anatomy/button.json); danger emphasis when the consequence is destructive

anatomyNotes: Same parts as dialog plus the mandatory cancel/action pair and the mandatory description; the close affordance is deliberately absent — an alert dialog is dismissed through its own actions, never a corner X. Salt has no separate AlertDialog: it composes Dialog with role=alertdialog and DialogActions — a composition difference, same anatomy. Size binds to the size-overlay-* width ramp, not control-height-*.
